ruleDefinitions.name: Uncommon AddinUtil.EXE CommandLine Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of the Add-In deployment cache updating utility (AddInutil.exe) with uncommon Addinroot or Pipelineroot paths. An adversary may execute AddinUtil.exe with uncommon Addinroot/Pipelineroot paths that point to the adversaries Addins.Store payload.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\addinutil\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "AddInUtil\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-AddInRoot\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-PipelineRoot\\:.*"))) AND  NOT ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-AddInRoot\\:\\"C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Common\\ Files\\\\Microsoft\\ Shared\\\\VSTA.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-AddInRoot\\:C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Common\\ Files\\\\Microsoft\\ Shared\\\\VSTA.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-PipelineRoot\\:\\"C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Common\\ Files\\\\Microsoft\\ Shared\\\\VSTA.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-PipelineRoot\\:C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Common\\ Files\\\\Microsoft\\ Shared\\\\VSTA.*")))
